projectDescription: A BepInEx mod for Gorilla Tag that replaces in-game bulletin boards with rotating Bible verses fetched from a live API, with offline fallback support.
keyFeatures: Replaces Gorilla Tag's in-game bulletin boards (MOTD and Code of Conduct) with Bible verses
Fetches random verses from bible-api.com across 8 books of the Bible
Offline mode with 20 hardcoded fallback verses when network is unavailable
Welcome splash message on startup, then rotates verses every 5 minutes
Built on BepInEx and Harmony for seamless mod patching with no game modification required
